# Agent Studio APIs — operations

14 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `agent-studio.create-agent` — **Create Agent** — `POST /agent-studio/agent` (write, location)
  Creates a new agent with staging version.
- `agent-studio.delete-agent` — **Delete Agent** — `DELETE /agent-studio/agent/{agentId}` (write, location)
  Deletes an agent and all its versions.
- `agent-studio.execute-agent` — **Execute Agent** — `POST /agent-studio/agent/{agentId}/execute` (write, location)
  Executes the specified agent and returns a non-streaming JSON response with the complete agent output.
- `agent-studio.execute-agent-deprecated` — **Execute Agent (Deprecated)** — `POST /agent-studio/public-api/agents/{agentId}/execute` (write, location, deprecated)
  DEPRECATED.
- `agent-studio.execute-managed-agent` — **Execute a published Managed Agent** — `POST /agent-studio/managed-agents/{managedAgentId}/execute` (write, location)
  Runs one JSON turn against the published production snapshot.
- `agent-studio.get-agent-by-id` — **Get Agent** — `GET /agent-studio/agent/{agentId}` (read, location)
  Gets a specific agent by its ID for the specified location with all its versions.
- `agent-studio.get-agent-by-id-deprecated` — **Get Agent (Deprecated)** — `GET /agent-studio/public-api/agents/{agentId}` (read, location, deprecated)
  DEPRECATED.
- `agent-studio.get-agents` — **List Agents** — `GET /agent-studio/agent` (read, location)
  Lists all active agents for the specified location.
- `agent-studio.get-agents-deprecated` — **List Agents (Deprecated)** — `GET /agent-studio/public-api/agents` (read, location, deprecated)
  DEPRECATED.
- `agent-studio.get-managed-agent` — **Get a published Managed Agent** — `GET /agent-studio/managed-agents/{managedAgentId}` (read, location)
  Returns public metadata for a published production Managed Agent.
- `agent-studio.list-managed-agents` — **List published Managed Agents** — `GET /agent-studio/managed-agents` (read, location)
  Returns only Managed Agents with a published production version in the authorized sub-account.
- `agent-studio.promote-and-publish` — **Promote to Production** — `POST /agent-studio/agent/versions/{versionId}/publish` (write, location)
  Promotes a draft version to production.
- `agent-studio.update-agent-metadata` — **Update Agent Metadata** — `PATCH /agent-studio/agent/{agentId}` (write, location)
  Updates agent metadata such as name, description, and status.
- `agent-studio.update-agent-version` — **Update Agent** — `PATCH /agent-studio/agent/versions/{versionId}` (write, location)
  Updates a specific agent version by versionId.
